name: a carnival strength-game becomes a two-metric comparison
looks: A silhouetted carnival scene holds two strongman bell-towers side by side, labelled for two different measures. A puck races up each tower to strike its bell, one tower lit a feeble colour for a small measure, the other blazing for a large one, an equation settling between them once both have struck.
build: Each tower's puck travels up its track on power3.out, triggering its bell and a labelled readout (value and short description) the instant it lands, same mechanic as data-infographic's bar build but vertical and single-shot per tower; the shared equation fades in centred once both towers have resolved.
sound: A mechanical ratchet as each puck rises, a bell strike on landing, pitched differently for the feeble and the mighty swing.
prompt: Reframe a carnival strongman game as a two-metric comparison: two labelled towers each send a puck racing up to strike a bell, one a feeble result, one a mighty one, with a short readout naming each value the instant it lands, and a shared equation settling between them once both have resolved, to make an abstract relationship physically legible.
